name: Mycelia
author: fluffy
description: A living kaleidoscope: Electric-Sheep-style fractal flames breathe with the bass, slime-mold spores grow a mycelium network along the flames, and a crowd of spores packs itself into the time, date and weekday.

intensity.label: Music intensity
intensity.hint: How hard the music pushes everything: bass swells the flame, beats kick the spores and flash the chromatic aberration. 0 = ignore audio and drift on its own.

symmetry.label: Flame symmetry (folds)
symmetry.hint: How many times the fractal flame is rotated around its centre. 1 = no symmetry (raw Electric Sheep), 6 = snowflake / mandala, 12 = dense kaleidoscope.

kaleido.label: Kaleidoscope fold (0=off)
kaleido.hint: Extra mirror-fold of the whole background into pie slices, like a physical kaleidoscope. Stacks on top of Flame symmetry; 0 turns it off.

fill.label: Flame tiles across screen
fill.hint: How many mirrored copies of the flame span the full width. auto = one per 16:9 worth of screen (two on a dual-monitor span). Mirrored, so seams stay continuous.

fillDepth.label: Corner fill (zoomed layer)
fillDepth.hint: Adds a slowly rotating, magnified copy of the flame's centre underneath, so the edges and corners get detail instead of staying dark.

palette.label: Palette
palette.hint: Colour scheme for the flame, the mycelium and the clock spores. Colours also drift slowly over time and shift with the bass.

flameSpeed.label: Flame evolution speed
flameSpeed.hint: How fast one flame 'genome' morphs into the next (like sheep changing in Electric Sheep) and how fast the colours cycle. 1 = a new shape roughly every 30 s.

warp.label: Domain warp
warp.hint: Liquid distortion of the background — noise bends the flame like heat haze, and bass makes it wobble harder. 0 = crisp, 2 = melting.

feedback.label: Echo / tunnel feedback
feedback.hint: Feeds the previous frame back in, slightly zoomed and rotated: creates trails and a tunnel-like echo. High values get very smeary.

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.hint: Glow around the bright parts. Pulses a little on every beat.

sporeDensity.label: Spore density
sporeDensity.hint: How many spores are simulated — both the free ones that grow the mycelium and the crowd that fills the clock. Costs GPU; the quality governor may lower it anyway.

sporeSpeed.label: Spore speed
sporeSpeed.hint: How fast spores crawl. Faster = wilder, more branching networks and a more restless clock crowd.

clockScale.label: Clock size
clockScale.hint: Size of the time, seconds and date on each monitor. 1 = digits about a quarter of the screen height.

clockX.label: Clock horizontal position
clockX.hint: Where the clock sits across each monitor: 0.05 at the left edge, 0.5 centred, 0.95 at the right edge.

clockY.label: Clock vertical position
clockY.hint: Where the clock sits on each monitor: 0.15 near the top, 0.5 centred, 0.85 near the bottom.

clockContrast.label: Clock shadow / solidity
clockContrast.hint: Darkens the background around the digits and lays a faint tint under the mold so the time always reads, even on the busiest frames. 0 = mold only.

showSeconds.label: Show seconds
showSeconds.hint: Small seconds next to the time. The crowd re-forms every second, which is most of the 'alive' feeling — but turn it off for a calmer clock.

showDate.label: Show day and date
showDate.hint: Second line under the time, e.g. TUE · SEP 15.
